choice_data_list: Tachyon, that was a great race!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-kun! Well, up to this point, 
you know.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, next up is the Satsuki Sho, 
huh...? I'll need to prepare accordingly.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's do our best in training!
Yeah, let's do our best with training!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Call it training, or... Well, that's just 
like you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, don't worry about it. Just talking to 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Right then, time is money! Straight home 
to research, research!
